summary: Iteration 8 backend + frontend E2E complete. All 14 new backend pytest tests pass (settings public/auth/put + non-admin 403 + currency/timezone directories, employee create with password login flow + default Welcome@123, payroll PDF admin/employee/forbidden, shift join uses Asia/Dhaka timezone, employee-status GPS check_in_location fallback, regression sanity). Frontend E2E validated Live Map search, Add Employee dialog + full flow, Settings Branding tab (after 1-line fix), Payroll PDF download returning application/pdf. Found & fixed one HIGH-priority frontend crash: SettingsPage referenced undefined `isAdmin` (ReferenceError) causing an ErrorBoundary trigger and the entire /dashboard/settings page to fail rendering. Added missing `const isAdmin = user?.role === 'super_admin' || user?.role === 'admin';`

ui_bugs.issue: Referenced undefined `isAdmin` variable on lines 54 and 197 (never declared) — caused ReferenceError, ErrorBoundary triggered, whole /dashboard/settings page crashed. Branding tab was never rendered. Fixed by adding `const isAdmin = user?.role === 'super_admin' || user?.role === 'admin';` after useTheme(). Verified fix — Branding tab and all 9 fields now render.

issues: 'Currency: ৳' shows only the symbol — consider appending currency code (e.g. 'Currency: ৳ BDT') for clarity.

action_items: (Already fixed by tester) SettingsPage was crashing due to undefined `isAdmin`. Please review /app/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/SettingsPage.js line 19.

Optional: make LocationStreamer explicitly no-op-safe when browser denies geolocation (harness cannot verify this end-to-end without permission grant). Confirmed the component is mounted from DashboardLayout and does not throw on load — page navigation and console remained clean.
Optional design: add currency code label alongside the symbol on Payroll header for readability.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPage: The `isAdmin` reference-before-definition indicates a missing lint rule (no-undef) or that a prior refactor lost the declaration — recommend adding `eslint no-undef: error` to the frontend config to catch this class of bug at build time.

AddEmployeeDialog: `department` field is captured in state but ignored on submit (only a no-op PUT with {address: null} is issued). The department value entered by the admin is silently discarded. Consider mapping it to `department_id` (creating on the fly) or removing the field until backend support is added.

payroll.py `download_payroll_pdf`: If `record["user_id"]` is stored inconsistently (string vs ObjectId) between iterations, the check `record['user_id'] != user['_id']` could false-positive. Currently both are strings — OK, but worth a helper for safety.

settings.py update_settings: When admin passes `currency_symbol` explicitly along with a `currency` code, the explicit symbol is honored (no override). Good. But the reverse — passing tz_offset_hours with a mismatching timezone code — silently keeps the mismatched offset. Consider always deriving from the directory when `timezone` is present.

shifts.py join_shift: `existing_session and existing_session.get('status') == 'joined'` — if a user joined, then ended, then tries to rejoin same day, they'll get another 'joined' session inserted (no 'you already ended for today' guard). Minor.

employees.py create_employee: The password is minimum 6 chars but there's no complexity requirement. The default 'Welcome@123' is fine, but user-provided passwords should enforce the same rules as /auth/register.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter8 regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_settings_payroll_tz.py — self-contained, uses pymongo directly for seeding. To exercise the timezone late-detection deterministically at any wall-clock time, the test accounts for grace-period (<=5 min → is_late=False) and only asserts strict late minutes when now_dhaka > 09:05. The SettingsPage `isAdmin` fix is a 1-line addition. Note the AddEmployeeDialog silently drops the department input — a known limitation.
rca_of_the_issue: SettingsPage.js line 54 `{isAdmin && (<TabsTrigger value="branding" ... />)}` and line 197 `{isAdmin && (<TabsContent ... />)}` referenced an `isAdmin` identifier that was never declared. React tolerates the undefined at parse time but at render the ReferenceError bubbles up, is caught by the ErrorBoundary, and the entire route stops rendering. Fix: derive `isAdmin` from the auth store: `const isAdmin = user?.role === 'super_admin' || user?.role === 'admin';` immediately after `const { user } = useAuthStore();`. Verified via Playwright: Branding tab + all 9 form fields (brand-name, welcome-title/subtitle, hero-title/subtitle, currency, timezone, logo-input, save button) render correctly for super_admin.
